newsitem.title: UK: Newcastle shares drop after Shearer injury.
newsitem.headline: Newcastle shares drop after Shearer injury.

text.p: Shares in Newcastle United Plc were marked lower in pre-market trade on Monday after the soccer club's star striker Alan Shearer was stretchered off in a pre-season match against Chelsea.

Shearer's ankle injury could keep the 15 million stg England player out of action for several months, a particular problem since Newcastle has just sold Les Ferdinand -- another top scorer -- to Tottenham Hotspur, dealers said.
Newcastle shares were down 8p at 115-1/2 by 0715 GMT in volume of 24,750 shares. Tottenham shares were quoted up 1p at 100-1/2, though no volume was recorded.
